protocol.method: For each 3-method block, common horizon is earliest CONTACT_READY control timestamp. Twenty equal intervals, rounded to recorded frame times; 360 independent boundary samples, existing evaluation contact radius. Report trapezoidal time-average covered fraction and maximum uncovered arc, plus all-frame robot path through same horizon. No transport control hold has started by that horizon.
protocol.endpoints: Retain existing full-task completion, G500 and hard-safety classifications separately.
protocol.inference: Paired descriptions across 12 reused fixed blocks; no population probability or independent holdout assertion.
